selection_basis: The system was selected from published observable geometry only: one foreground galaxy, three spectroscopic source planes, spatially resolved stellar kinematics, HST imaging, and public-archive identifiers. No gravity residual, dark-matter slope, subhalo score, or alternative-gravity parameter was used to select it.

primary_sources.role: resolved stellar kinematics and accepted dynamical support
third source plane and three published ring radii
spectroscopic redshift of the second source plane
recent three-source-plane pixel-level lens analysis and data-product search target

published_lens_geometry.third_source_radius_note: The published 2.5-arcsec value is an approximate or naive Einstein radius inferred from the two-image separation, not an additional directly measured image location. The two reported image radii are 1.35 and 3.56 arcsec, so only one is inside the current 1.95-arcsec accepted dynamics support.
published_lens_geometry.important_limit: Three rings are a pre-fit geometric upper bound, not proof of three independent marginalized Weyl-response modes. Pixel likelihoods, source-plane nuisance parameters, and cross-plane covariance must still be propagated.

published_dynamics_support.published_exclusion_reason: The outer kinematics are not dynamically simple; the paper cites an asymmetric envelope and possible tidal interaction, so its oblate-axisymmetric Jeans models exclude the nine outermost bins.
published_dynamics_support.accepted_support_definition: For admission to the ten-system identifiability sample, accepted same-support dynamics stop at 1.95 arcsec. Merely measuring light or kinematics to 2.7 arcsec does not authorize counting rings outside the model-valid support.

repair_hypothesis.description: A future non-axisymmetric or tidal dynamical model could attempt to validate the measured 1.95-2.7 arcsec kinematics. This is a new upstream dynamics result, not a reinterpretation of the published accepted support.
required_checks: retain all predeclared azimuthal sectors spanning each of the three ring radii
pass opposite-half and quadrant consistency checks
include PSF, template, sky, binning, and tidal/asymmetry systematics in the covariance
show that the outer response is not driven by the nine bins rejected by the published axisymmetric model
freeze the full numerical reduction and model-validity thresholds before science-array inspection
repair_hypothesis.promotion_rule: Only a separately preregistered repair analysis that passes every check may raise the same-support rank ceiling above one. Failure preserves this candidate as rank-one and triggers replacement; it does not relax the 2.5-arcsec requirement.

eso_muse.required_before_download: Pass the frozen geometry gate or freeze a separate outer-dynamics repair protocol that can make the gate testable.

required_lens_products: image-plane pixels and PSF with immutable archive provenance
noise or exposure products sufficient to construct a likelihood
three source-plane redshifts and source-plane nuisance model
observable-level image or surface-brightness likelihood usable without importing a GR-fitted mass posterior
full cross-plane covariance or the ingredients to reconstruct it
required_baryonic_products: published MGE parameters as a check, not as a fixed GR-derived baryonic truth
stellar-population mass-to-light nuisance prior including IMF and radial-gradient alternatives

decision_rules.admit_to_new_rank_three_candidate_queue: All geometry, accepted-dynamics, public-archive, likelihood, baryonic, and covariance gates pass without using a gravity residual.
decision_rules.retain_as_repair_candidate: Raw MUSE and HST products are public and traceable, but current accepted same-support rank is below three; a separately frozen outer-dynamics repair remains possible.
decision_rules.reject_and_replace: The public data cannot support a model-valid dynamics result through 2.5 arcsec, observable-level lens likelihood, or independently propagated covariance.

progress_checkpoint.time_box: one metadata/source-product audit plus one frozen outer-dynamics feasibility audit
progress_checkpoint.advance_if: The repair route is demonstrably testable with public products and an a priori numerical validity gate through at least 2.5 arcsec.
progress_checkpoint.rethink_if: No public observable-level lens likelihood is recoverable, or the frozen outer-dynamics feasibility gate cannot validate 2.5 arcsec support. Stop work on this object and search another triple-source-plane or extended-lensing galaxy; do not spend a reduction cycle on a rank-one endpoint.
